card.name: Daily before dose in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word daily (or frequency) right after total, reduce the, or dose, where the next word is dose or dosage. Also a blank space after a dosing heading.

modes.label: Total daily dose
modes.description: The word daily after total or reduce the, just before dose or dosage.
modes.example: starting oral dosage of CLOZARIL is 12.5 mg once or twice daily. If well-tolerated, increase the total<< daily>> dose in increments of 25 mg

modes.label: Dose frequency
modes.description: The word frequency after dose or dosage, in tables or adjustment instructions.
modes.example: for Patients with Severe Hepatic Impairment For patients with severe hepatic impairment (Child Pugh-C), reduce the VERZENIO dosage<< frequency>> to once daily [see Use in Specific

modes.label: Space after dose heading
modes.description: A blank space after a heading such as Maintenance Dose, before the amount.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; it slightly favors Chinese words meaning total and disfavors factor or coefficient words.
card.plain: It fires on the word daily in phrases like total daily dose, and on dose frequency wording.
